custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the physical plausibility of how the beads are connected. In real necklaces, there must be visible string, wire, or links holding the beads together. If the beads appear to touch directly without a connector, or if they float slightly apart, this is a strong indicator of AI generation. Also, scrutinize the lighting on the matte surfaces; AI often struggles to render consistent diffuse reflections on non-metallic curved objects. Ensure the open_vocabulary_detector successfully isolates each bead before the topology auditor checks for fusion.
image_description: A chunky, multi-strand necklace composed of dark, matte-finished oval beads or discs displayed on a white mannequin bust. The necklace features a dense arrangement of these elements, creating a bib-style appearance around the neck area.
